findings.quoted_text: Contractor shall also perform any additional services Client reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge.
Client may request unlimited revisions until Client is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
Contractor shall also perform any additional services Client reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge.
findings.explanation: You are required to perform additional services requested by the client during the term without receiving any extra pay, which creates an open-ended obligation to work for free.
findings.suggested_change: Any additional services requested by the Client shall be agreed upon in writing and billed at the Contractor's standard hourly rates or via a separate mutually agreed statement of work.

findings.quoted_text: Client may request unlimited revisions until Client is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: The client can demand an unlimited number of revisions without additional compensation until they are fully satisfied, which can trap you in endless revision cycles.
findings.suggested_change: Client may request up to three rounds of revisions per Deliverable, and any further revisions will be billed at the Contractor's standard hourly rates.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am excited to work together, but I would like to suggest a couple of updates before signing. - In the relevant clause regarding additional services, the text requires performing extra work without extra pay, which creates an open-ended obligation; I propose that any additional services be agreed upon in writing and billed at standard rates. - In the relevant clause regarding revisions, the agreement allows unlimited revisions without additional compensation until full satisfaction; I propose limiting this to up to three rounds of revisions per deliverable, with further revisions billed at standard hourly rates. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards,
